description: This file defines test constants used for unit testing within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It includes nested classes for Authorization, Feature, Thing, and Metadata, each containing static final fields with sample objects, IDs, properties, and other constants related to testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestConstants
classes.description: Container class holding nested static classes for various testing constants related to authorization, features, things, and metadata.

classes.name: TestConstants.Authorization
classes.description: Contains authorization-related test constants, including sample AuthorizationSubject objects and ACL entries.

classes.name: TestConstants.Feature
classes.description: Holds feature-related test constants like feature IDs, properties, definitions, and sample feature objects.

classes.name: TestConstants.Thing
classes.description: Encapsulates constants related to a Thing entity, including IDs, lifecycle, attributes, features, policies, and sample instance objects.

classes.name: TestConstants.Metadata
classes.description: Defines metadata test constants, such as sample metadata objects.

methods.name: AssertionError()
methods.description: Private constructor for utility classes that throws AssertionError to prevent instantiation.
